rules.rule: A Jesus Freak life-stage transition MUST be represented by an explicit verified graph relation; agents MUST NOT invent a transition.
KornucopiaHall resources MUST have an explicit availability/capacity state before an episode can consume them.
A character's inhabitation of a Garden place MUST be represented by INHABITS or an equivalent verified relation.
A production artifact MUST reference the Garden package version used to create it.
